author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if the smallest rituals in our homes are the threads that quietly bind generations together? Nikita Kanani is a GP and national health leader. In her talk with her daughter, Naia, she explores how heritage and everyday rituals shape identity, belonging, and the stories we pass to future generations.

Naia Kanani-Ferdinand is thirteen and part of a line of four generations of living female ritual-makers. Speaking with her mum, Nikita Kanani, she shows how playful traditions create connection and belonging, helping us understand who we are and become. 

This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Why your family rituals matter | Nikita Kanani & Naia Kanani-Ferdinand | TEDxAlleyns School Youth
